title: Does export to Android come with built in touch control support?

posts.author: greyskingames
posts.body: Does export to Android come with built in touch control support? I have been looking and can find an answer... Like a touchpad built in when you export the game?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Yes and no. RPG Maker MZ doesn't have any "export to Android," so there's no touchpad that magically appears on certain operating systems.
However, tapping a touchscreen is the same input as a mouse click, so it does have built-in support for that.
I'm sure you can Google a plugin to add an on-screen touchpad.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
There are basic touch guestures can be recognized by the browser so it is at least playable.
For example, click the screen using the second finger while the fist finger is still on the screen is recognized as right click (menu and cancel). And MZ has screen buttons by default, even if the guesture doesn't work.
